limits: Candidate Vite prototype only; four alternating trials with natural speed1 play. Final4x baseline reaches25actions/5ultimates/161events; other7runs26/6/171. Fixed32s windows end at different actions; final states differ. Common ordered prefix is checked separately, not gameplay equivalence. Local preparation is not a cold-network measurement. CPU render submission excludes GPU completion. 4x is a stress proxy; observations do not establish a speedup. Each screenshot is taken after its timed window, not at a matched action timestamp.
